### None Too Old to Serve the King
Author: Greg Morse
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/none-too-old-to-serve-the-king
Passage: 2 Samuel 19:33
Points:
- Barzillai demonstrated true loyalty by supplying King David during his vulnerable exile in the wilderness.
- Hardship tests commitment, exposing fair-weather followers while revealing genuine devotion.
- In gratitude for his selfless service, David invited Barzillai to accompany him and share his royal triumph in Jerusalem.
- Christians are called to stand with and serve King Jesus today, even while His kingship remains largely unacknowledged by the world.
- Advanced age does not sideline believers; no one is ever too old to serve the King.
